name: Apple Inc

decision.rationale: HOLD — Apple raising iPhone/iPad/Mac prices on higher memory costs confirms it would rather pass cost through than cancel orders, which is bullish for the AI-memory complex you also hold, but the price hikes risk unit demand and the stock just took a multiple hit, so it is a steadier-hands name rather than an add here.

bull: Pricing power: raising hardware prices into a memory-cost shock without losing the ecosystem is something almost no other consumer-hardware maker can do — services keep compounding underneath.
bear: Higher prices into a soft consumer could finally bend the upgrade cycle, and as a mega-cap it offers little shelter when the broad tape de-rates.
